questions.q: What makes the Metadata API categorically different from every other API covered in this course?
options: It's the only one that requires authentication
It moves org configuration/metadata (fields, flows, profiles), not application data, unlike REST, SOAP, Bulk, Composite, and Streaming which all move data
It is the only API that uses JSON
It is the newest API Salesforce has released
questions.explain: Every other API in this course moves data in some form; Metadata API moves the definitions that describe the org's own structure and configuration.

questions.q: A nightly job needs to load 2 million transaction records from an ERP system into Salesforce. Which API best fits, per this lesson's framework?
options: The REST API, looping one record at a time
Bulk API 2.0, since this is a large-volume, non-time-critical asynchronous load
The Streaming API
Salesforce Connect
questions.explain: This is exactly Bulk API 2.0's use case: large volume, not time-critical, well suited to the asynchronous job model.

questions.q: A fulfillment system needs to know within seconds whenever an Order's status changes to "Shipped," without polling. Which API fits best?
options: SOAP API
Streaming API / Platform Events / Change Data Capture
Metadata API
GraphQL API
questions.explain: This is a real-time, push-based notification need — exactly what the Streaming API family (including Change Data Capture) is designed for, avoiding the need to poll.

questions.q: A dashboard needs an Account with all its related Contacts and Opportunities in one call, shaped exactly for the UI. Which API is the best fit?
options: The GraphQL API, since it lets the client request exactly the nested shape it needs in one round trip
The Metadata API
Bulk API 2.0
Salesforce Connect
questions.explain: GraphQL is specifically suited to flexible, deeply nested data-shape requests in one round trip, which fits a dashboard needing a specific combined shape.

questions.q: A company needs to deploy 30 new custom fields from a sandbox into production. Which API handles this?
options: Bulk API 2.0, treating each field as a record
REST API, creating each field via /sobjects
Metadata API, since this is moving configuration, not application data
Streaming API
questions.explain: Deploying configuration like custom fields is Metadata API's job — it's categorically different from moving application data, regardless of how many fields are involved.
